class.name: mecanum_pico/MecanumPicoHardware
class.description: Mecanum drive hardware interface for a Raspberry Pi Pico connected via USB-CDC serial. Controls 4 independent mecanum wheels (front_left, front_right, rear_left, rear_right). Serial protocol: "m fl fr rl rr\r" for commands, "e fl fr rl rr\r" for encoder feedback.
